steers.title: 5 recent losses look like wrong-side trades
steers.detail: Multiple losses >2% of position suggest we're fading momentum. Check if signals are aligned with trend.

deep_analysis:
PORTFOLIO: 1 open trade — ETC LONG (bb-bounce-v2-long+), +0.32%, meta_rsi 50.0, 12min open. 5 slots free. 24h closed: 6W/8L (42.9% WR), net +0.67 USDT.

REGIME CONFLICT: 5m scanner says SHORT_BIAS (77/124 tokens short vs 5 long). BTC 15m and 4h both SHORT_BIAS. Market phase DECLINING. But BTC sits ABOVE EMA300 on 1m (STRONG_UP trend quality, 798 consecutive bars above). This is a market rolling over from above — intermediate trend is down, immediate structure still up. The SHORT_BIAS side is winning: 77 tokens declining vs 5 advancing.

ETC LONG ASSESSMENT: This is a chop trade. ETC ranging 7.73-7.77, ATR too low to arm trail (+0.40% threshold). Previous ETC LONG same signal (id 16272) hit hard_max_loss -4.13% yesterday. Same coin, same signal, same RSI 50. The thesis was a BB bounce, but BB bounces in low-vol chop are exactly the 0% WR hard_max_loss pattern. BTC 15m SHORT_BIAS means this LONG is fighting the intermediate trend. Would I open this fresh? No — regime is short-biased, coin is dead flat, trail can't arm. However: only 12min open, stop at 7.663 is tight (0.95% risk), and BTC above EMA300 provides some cushion. Not urgent to exit yet, but if it doesn't reach +0.40% trail arm within 1-2 hours it becomes a stale chop hold.

WINNING SIDE ANALYSIS (last 24h): Winners were BTC LONGs via continuum-trend+ (+0.30%, +1.33%) and ai-trader-manual (+4.31%) — following BTC's above-EMA300 structure. HBAR SHORT pump-chain- won +3.29% at RSI 54.5. ALT SHORT pump-chain- won +4.22% at RSI 63.3. The winning formula: SHORT at RSI 54-63 (not oversold), or LONG BTC itself (not alts) when BTC structure is up. Losers: BTC SHORT ai-trader-pending -5.36% (shorted BTC while it was rising — wrong side of the strongest trend), HYPE SHORT at RSI 38.1 (shorting oversold — BANANA lesson), IO LONG trail_arm_timeout -2.11% (never reached +0.40%). Pattern: we lose when we fight BTC's direction or enter alts during chop.
regime_context: SHORT_BIAS across the board: 5m scanner 77 short vs 5 long tokens. BTC 15m SHORT_BIAS, 4h SHORT_BIAS. Market phase DECLINING. Volume LOW, velocity SLOW, acceleration POSITIVE (trying to stabilize). BTC at 82,603, above EMA300 (82,343) for 798 bars — structure still up but momentum fading (15m linreg slope -0.045). Z-score NEUTRAL, volatility LOW. Interpretation: BTC topping process. Intermediate trend down, immediate structure not yet broken. SHORT alts that are already declining is the highest-probability side. LONG BTC itself is defensible while above EMA300. LONG altcoins in this regime is fighting 77-token short bias — low win rate.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERNS (PostgreSQL, last 24h, n=14 closed):

1. SHORTS: 3 atr_sl_hit losses avg -2.93%, 1 win (HBAR +3.29%). Losers entered at RSI 38.1 (oversold) and 66.7. Winner entered at RSI 54.5. WINNING SIDE: short at RSI 50-60 when token has confirmed SHORT_BIAS momentum. We weren't on it because we shorted oversold (HYPE RSI 38) — shorting into exhaustion is catching a falling knife.

2. ALTS LONG in SHORT_BIAS regime: bb-bounce-v2-long+ has 42.3% WR, -0.52 total PnL (26 trades). ETC LONG lost -4.13% hard_max_loss at RSI 50 yesterday, same setup as the current open trade. BANANA LONG -2.24% at RSI 58.3. IO LONG -2.11% trail_arm_timeout. WINNING SIDE: these coins were declining — the right trade was SHORT or no trade. We were buying bounces in a downtrend.

3. VOLUME-BREAKOUT-LONG+ is the worst signal: 17 trades, 17.6% WR, -1.03 total PnL. This signal fires longs on volume spikes that are distribution, not accumulation. In SHORT_BIAS regime, volume spikes on alts are usually panic selling — the LONG side loses.

4. BTC LONG works: continuum-trend+ 80% WR (5 trades), ai-trader-manual BTC trades all won (+4.31%, +2.39%, +4.18%). BTC above EMA300 is the one reliable LONG. Alts in this regime are not.
